categories.name: architecture_and_recovery
categories.evidence: Batch039 tracked and untracked work was compared with verified SD recovery copies; Batch040 recovery snapshot was created before edits; six historical Doctor reports and the Batch039 Doctor report remain preserved. Architecture map is in batch040-recovery-and-architecture.md.

categories.name: offline_adapter_and_graph_identity
categories.evidence: The opt-in local adapter checks graph format/schema/counts/fingerprint/hash, pinned coverage report, capability flags, endpoint coordinates, route geometry and distance provenance. PHP lint passed before the final cooperative-deadline edit; final lint is recorded separately. The focused PHP adapter test did not complete after its fixture correction.

categories.name: cooperative_route_deadline
categories.evidence: OfflinePedestrianGraphRouter now accepts an optional monotonic deadline and checks between SQLite phases and bounded PHP loops. PDO SQLite statements cannot be interrupted mid-statement; this is not a hard timeout. A zero-budget fixture was added but not executed.

categories.name: journey_preview_integration
categories.evidence: Preview requests bind to selected-journey identity, abort on route changes and ignore stale responses. Preview removal restores the unmodified journey. The focused offline-preview frontend harness passed in the second guarded run; the full commute-card harness stopped at a stale distance-label fixture and was corrected but not rerun.

categories.name: coverage_diagnostics
categories.evidence: The carried-forward summarizer completed against the SHA-pinned Batch032 report (SHA-256 6caf101177904bee6fda1b12cab9c5cda36ddaf7ecc08b0d9778c0517123c81b). It validates stored coordinate ranges: 503/503 stops and 37/37 places; reports 49 stop cells and 17 place cells on a 0.01-degree record grid, with zero cells meeting the stated 3-record/<50%-snapped review threshold; separates graph component, trust, city-ID and transfer evidence. It did not open SQLite or PBF and did not replay routes. Synthetic fixtures remain unrun.

categories.name: offline_corpus_framework
categories.evidence: The replay command emits indexed cases, source endpoint IDs/trust labels, route reasons, snaps, edge identity and geometry continuity; the comparator now checks the exact indexed case identity and top-level PASS. Batch040 real replay and comparator execution were not reached.

categories.name: ride_mode_and_saved_journeys
categories.evidence: Existing manual Ride Mode and v1 saved snapshots are reused; development preview data is rejected at save/parse boundaries. Related full regression harnesses did not run after the final code changes. No storage migration was added.

categories.name: map_and_mobile
categories.evidence: Existing MapLibre geometry filtering and map/list selection are reused; preview endpoint connectors are not emitted as graph geometry. No browser, viewport, keyboard or screen-reader interaction ran.

categories.name: validation_ledger_and_scheduler
categories.evidence: The validation-ledger harness passed in the first bounded run and checks source/config/tool/runtime/command fingerprints, evidence SHA, interrupted RUNNING precedence and BLOCKED/FAIL precedence. The broader second run was canceled by the resource guard. The scheduler recorded the resource stop and did not reuse a PASS.

categories.name: portable_linux_kit
categories.evidence: The package contains 35 source snapshot files, required external artifacts and version constraints. verify-kit.sh passed all 38 SHA256SUMS entries, manifest validation, exact checkout revision b723f78653d76e1796f2980e7a414b29782ae01b, and byte identity of packaged source copies on Termux. This is package integrity only; external host execution remains NOT_RUN.

categories.name: real_postgresql_staging_and_live_graph_api
categories.evidence: No PostgreSQL cluster was started or contacted. The SQLite adapter remains opt-in, local-only and separate from the production journey API.

categories.name: field_transfer_safety_and_private_beta
categories.evidence: Both transfer locations remain UNVERIFIED. Graph connectivity is not field evidence. No field observations, real database staging, staged route parity, or browser-level tests were produced. Private beta remains blocked.
